methodology.outlier_policy: retain all valid samples; no trimming
methodology.percentiles: nearest rank; median averages middle pair
methodology.warmup: 2 per microbenchmark group and 2 PTY/comparison invocations; output/idle report no warmup
methodology.clocks: monotonic; microseconds are serialization units, not a precision guarantee
methodology.allocation: separate feature build; System allocation/reallocation requests and logical live bytes; allocator metadata/RSS/internal realloc overlap unobserved
methodology.micro_timing: setup, validation and returned-value drop excluded; drops inside operation included; control/timer floor recorded
methodology.pty: includes scheduler/IPC and kernel PTY delivery; does not measure emulator repaint or physical display
methodology.authority: recorded development VM; descriptive baseline, not a regression-grade isolated bare-metal lab
